changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0003. Create Tenants. Index review: clustered PK_Tenants on Id. OwnerUserId is nullable until Users exists, so its index and foreign key are added in LF-0005. TenantType and Status are not indexed: Part 2 does not list tenants by those columns. Performance note: the table is empty at creation and the statement only updates metadata.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.Tenants ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Name NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, TenantType NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, OwnerUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_Tenants PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_Tenants_TenantType CHECK (TenantType IN (N'Personal', N'Gym', N'YogaStudio', N'CrossFit', N'Physio', N'Corporate')), CONSTRAINT CK_Tenants_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Active', N'Suspended', N'Inactive')) );

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0004. Create Users. TenantId is the personal tenant, never a business workspace. Index review: PK_Users on Id; IX_Users_TenantId supports the personal-tenant foreign key and owner lookup; UX_Users_Email is the login and uniqueness key for active rows; UX_Users_Phone enforces uniqueness only when a phone is stored. Performance note: both unique indexes are filtered, so soft-deleted rows do not block reuse and the phone index stays narrow.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.Users ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Email NVARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, Phone NVARCHAR(32) NULL, PasswordHash NVARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, PasswordSalt NVARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, FirstName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, LastName NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, LastLoginAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_Users PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_Users_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_Users_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Active', N'Disabled')) ); CREATE INDEX IX_Users_TenantId ON app.Users (TenantId); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Users_Email ON app.Users (Email) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Users_Phone ON app.Users (Phone) WHERE Phone IS NOT NULL AND DeletedAt IS NULL;

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0005. Add Tenants.OwnerUserId foreign key after Users exists so the two tables can be created without a circular dependency. Index review: IX_Tenants_OwnerUserId supports the foreign key and "tenants owned by this user". Filtered to non-null owners so personal rows that are not yet linked are not indexed. Performance note: the index is created on an empty column and does not scan user pages.

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IX_Tenants_OwnerUserId ON app.Tenants; ALTER TABLE app.Tenants DROP CONSTRAINT FK_Tenants_Users;

changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0006. Create TenantMembers for workspace membership. Index review: PK_TenantMembers on Id; UX_TenantMembers_TenantId_UserId prevents a second active membership and serves tenant-to-member lookups; IX_TenantMembers_UserId serves "workspaces for this user", which is the switcher query. Performance note: the unique index is filtered to active rows so a removed membership can be replaced.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE app.TenantMembers ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, Status NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, JoinedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, UpdatedBy UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_TenantMembers PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_TenantMembers_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_TenantMembers_Users FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_TenantMembers_Status CHECK (Status IN (N'Active', N'Removed')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_TenantMembers_TenantId_UserId ON app.TenantMembers (TenantId, UserId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_TenantMembers_UserId ON app.TenantMembers (UserId, TenantId) WHERE DeletedAt IS NULL;
